narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>To find the angle between two rays, add the two readings together.
<bookmark mark='inside'/>Look at the rays queue and are. They lie inside the bigger angle from pee to are.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A part inside an angle cannot be bigger than the whole angle, so adding must be wrong.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Read every ray on one scale, then take the smaller reading away from the larger one.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Joseph's two rays read fifteen and one hundred and fifteen on the same scale. What is the angle between them?
